# Original template service composition

The generator invokes the active original local-client composition with scripted
providers. It does not start the application, read accounts/settings or contact
services. Five cases cover intersecting and distant trenches, reduction from
15 distant regions retained individually by the installed v3 context patch,
provider phase order, the empty-road terrain fallback,
path direction semantics, union of repeated source surface features and merged
contexts independent of the interactive download window. The service adapter uses
the original BRT/BGT profile-context protocol with shared cancellation and bounded
page/cache budgets.

Both native planners use this composition before publication. Fresh service
data supplies the overview and profile context. The active original desktop
map route uses its selected CAD overlays rather than these service vectors;
that distinction is retained. Offline mode uses loaded context and suppresses
network imagery even if a saved preference requests an aerial background.

Tests compare original bounds, requests, output geometry and cancellation/error
rollback. The standalone driver writes five complete paired DXFs. Independent
Python readback compares complete original-written overview entities, surface geometry,
layer/font inputs, drawing order, ownership and CAD audit results. These local
transports do not establish real provider or user acceptance.
